messages.text: Hi do you have european warehouse / supplies

Yes, we ship to Europe and have EU warehouse stock on several units.

The B.4 itself isn't shipping from the EU though, and it's off sale right now while BitFortun fixes its firmware. Where are you based, and what are you looking to mine?
are your warehouse in europe or is the item being shipped into europe when I place an order?

Both, depending on the unit. We hold real stock in Rotterdam — those ship from inside the EU with import VAT already in the price, usually a couple of business days.

Drop-shipped units (B30, Magic Miner, BitFortun, PunkHash) come in from the manufacturer, so 21% import VAT and duty are charged on delivery.

Which country are you in?
germany
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 Thor P2 miner
Read the magic miner 40t page

Good news on the BS-4: it's live and buyable, $599.99, ships October 31, 2026. But it's drop-shipped, so into Germany you'd pay 21% import VAT plus any duty on delivery — we don't collect that at checkout.

Shipping from our Rotterdam stock (BC04 at $249, DC02 EU kit) has the VAT already in.

Is the BS-4's 18 TH/s what you're after, or just the first miner?
Yes this i what i am after, but if I have a 21% vat then at this current juncture it is not worth it

The 21% is customs, not us, and I can't waive it — on $599.99 that's roughly $126 on delivery.

Two things worth knowing. If you're buying as a VAT-registered business in Germany, you can reclaim it, and we can get you a proper invoice — say the word and Georges picks that up right here.

Otherwise the Rotterdam-stocked units have VAT already in the price, no bill at the door. Business or private?
what miner are currently being shipped from Rootter

Right now, out of Rotterdam into Germany: the Hammer BC04 (6 TH/s, ~100W) at $249, and the DC02 Scrypt kit for Doge/Litecoin at $239.99 — about two business days.

The T. P2 (10 TH/s, ~166W, $379) also sits in EU stock; let me confirm that one before you buy on it.

Nothing in the 18 TH class is EU-held — that's the honest trade-off.
Rotterdam

Yes — Rotterdam is our EU warehouse, VAT included, no customs bill on arrival.

For Bitcoin, the BC04 is the one I'd take from there: 6 TH/s at about 100W, $249, ships in a couple of business days with a type F plug.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run the sats and the power cost for you.
okay thanks I will wait until that class can be shipped from Rotterdam
Used the chat-interview skill

Fair enough. I'll keep an eye out for EU-held stock in that class.

Before you go, one thing: was it the 18 TH/s specifically you wanted, or the water cooling on the BS-4?
Any of the2 will do, I am after a 20TH/s system running BM1373 chip or better with a power usage of +/- 300w to -325w

Then the Harlo B30 is your other match: same BM1373 chips, 24 TH/s at 350W in Balanced, 30 TH/s at 485W Turbo, 18 TH/s at 230W in ECO. $899.

Same catch as the BS-4 though — drop-shipped, so 21% VAT on delivery. Nothing in that class sits in Rotterdam today.

Want me to flag you for EU stock in that class?
Yes, but he price is outside of my investment budget, I dont intend to sell my gpu rigs to get ASIC miner
